John Lin

Sounds like a plan, Klaus. I'll shoot you an email later today to confirm the details and suggest some times that work for me. Looking forward to our meeting.
Klaus Mueller
That sounds perfect, John. I'll be waiting for your email and looking forward to our meeting.
John Lin
It was nice chatting with you, Klaus. I’ll send that email shortly.
Klaus Mueller
Thanks, John. I’ll be on the lookout for your email and we can finalize the details then.
John Lin
It was nice chatting with you, Klaus. I’ll send that email shortly.
Klaus Mueller
Sounds good, John. Take care until then.
